patches.name: Bypass Stock Limit
patches.description: Restores the features that the stock keyboard only allows to the privileged stock build: the cloud signers, the configuration sync and the SecKit identity report "com.oplus.keyboard", the translation and theme requests embed it, and the AI writing key opens the AI writer through its unprotected text selection entrance instead of the "com.oplus.permission.safe.SAU" protected service.

patches.name: Change Identity
patches.description: Gives the patched keyboard its own identity so it can coexist with the privileged, stock-signed build: the package becomes "com.realme.keyboard", the launcher and input method picker label becomes "realmeow Keyboard" / "真奇喵输入法" / "真奇喵輸入法" by locale, and everything the rename would otherwise break is repaired (provider authorities, the dynamic receiver permission, the exported IME service and the hardcoded content:// authorities).

patches.name: Enable Inline Autofill
patches.description: Declares the keyboard as an inline-autofill capable IME (android:supportsInlineSuggestions in the input method descriptor), so the autofill framework offers password manager fill suggestions to it. The declaration is the whole patch: drawing the fill bubble is done by the companion module, not by the keyboard.
